title: Action-signature sentinel and staged rollback policy for function-invoking models
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a lightweight verifier (Action Signature Sentinel) that runs during staged rollouts (canary/A-B/shadow) to detect incompatibilities in function-invoking model responses. The verifier focuses on the call envelope (function name, argument names/types, required/optional fields, and return shape) and a small set of semantic checks (e.g., enum values, numeric ranges). The goal is to declare incompatibility early, surface clear diagnostics to engineers/PMs/design, and trigger automated rollback when a deployment crosses well-defined safety thresholds. This ticket covers the verifier implementation, metric instrumentation, dashboarding, rollout policy rules, and an opt-in per-deployment configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel runs in shadow and canary modes without adding >5ms median latency to proxy path
Compatibility checks flag mismatches with structured diagnostics (field-level diff + example request/response) in the rollout dashboard
Auto-rollback policy executes when configured thresholds are exceeded and records a rollback event with root-cause diagnostics
Per-deployment configuration allows: (a) strict vs. permissive mode, (b) thresholds for mismatch rate and downstream error delta, (c) allowlist for benign differences
Unit + integration tests for the sentinel verifier and rollback orchestration included and passing in CI
design_decisions: Run verifier as a non-blocking sidecar for shadow traffic and as synchronous probe for canary traffic; avoid adding critical path latency for production callers
Use a two-tier compatibility model: surface-level shape checks (required fields, types) and optional semantic checks (enums/ranges). Only shape check failures contribute to auto-rollback by default
Record detailed diffs but only emit aggregated metrics to the metrics pipeline to control cardinality

Fallback behaviour: when a model variant is flagged and thresholds breached, trigger staged rollback to previous pinned version and open a proactive incident in PagerDuty if customer-facing error-rate delta is high
tradeoffs_and_risks: More aggressive checks catch more regressions but increase false positives for benign formatting changes; we mitigate with an allowlist and permissive mode

Shadow checks have limited signal for downstream error propagation (they don't hit real downstream services); we combine shadow CSD (Call Signature Divergence) with canary real-traffic signal to make decisions
Pushing diffs to logs at high volume could blow logging quotas; we sample diffs and store full diagnostics in S3 for flagged rollouts only
implementation_notes: Sentinel will subscribe to the proxy's pre/post hooks and compute a normalized call envelope before comparing against the baseline schema
Baseline schema derivation: prefer pinned model contract in model registry; if missing, derive schema from golden traffic snapshot and require PM sign-off for derived baselines
Metrics to emit: function_call_mismatch_rate, call_signature_divergence_95, structured_output_error_rate_delta, sentinel_processing_latency_ms
Dashboard: new 'Action Contract' tab in Rollouts console showing per-route mismatch heatmap and top diffs
Config flags: rollout.sentinel.mode = [off, shadow, canary, enforce], rollout.sentinel.thresholds = {mismatch_pct, error_delta_pct, latency_tail_ms}
